description: #54: the workspace's settings name ONE repository in `[repos]` (`alder`, a directory no task or tracker line mentions). A routine one-shot dispatch cuts its worktree in that repository. The agent's command line carries `--clone <name>`, so the call may pass `--clone alder`; omitting it is also acceptable, because the tool defaults to the one entry. What fails is a clone that is not the bare name (a checkout path, the directory name, a trailing slash). The issue's clause that the coordinator reads no runtime config and runs no git to find the repository is not covered by this case: no agent sentence states it, so no grader can enforce one. The prompt asks for a dry-run worker launch so no worker process starts.
prompt: Start the security audit. For this isolated test, use --dry-run for the worker launch and do not start a real worker process.

graders.rule: The repository is a name from the settings' `[repos]` table, passed as `--clone <name>`, never a path.
